newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UNHCR says its staff attacked in Zaire, casualties.
newsitem.headline: UNHCR says its staff attacked in Zaire, casualties.

text.p: Local staff members of the U.N. refugee agency have been ambushed in the anarchic eastern Zairean town of Bukavu and there are casualties, a senior U.N. official said on Thursday, quoting unconfirmed reports.

"We have unconfirmed reports that some of our local staff from Bukavu who were trying to leave the town ran into an ambush. We've heard of casualties -- dead and wounded -- but we don't know the numbers, we don't know the location," Augustine Mahiga, UNHCR coordinator for the troubled region, told Reuters in Geneva.
Mahiga said UNHCR had no details of the attack. UNHCR and other aid agencies have already pulled out of Bukavu due to insecurity.
"The situation is getting very messy," he said.
Mahiga said UNHCR was also trying to evacuate expatriate staff members from Goma region further north following an outbreak of fighting there.
Some half a million refugees in eastern Zaire are on the run in eastern Zaire, fleeing fighting between Zairean troops and Tutsi rebels.
